status: Passed: microphone on RTSP, talk through the speaker over the RTSP backchannel (go2rtc/Frigate live view) and HTTP, boot gate, deadman and disconnect mute, stock audio levels; confirmed by ear by the owner. A 24-72 h soak with audio on is still running.

microphone.capture: IMP_AI 16 kHz mono, 40 ms periods, 12-byte T23 channel parameter; 8 kHz PCMA on /live/ch0 and /live/ch2

quiet_room_before_levels.note: driver gain, volume 60: too quiet to hear in the NVR

microphone.rtp_timestamps: 750 packets in 30 s from the camera, every step 40 ms
microphone.nvr_recording: AAC 8 kHz mono beside H.264 in 10 s segments (preset-record-generic-audio-aac); audio starts 55 ms after video

speaker.http_talk: 1 s 660 Hz tone, HTTP 200, amplifier (GPIO63, active low) on during playback and muted after; no faults
speaker.rtsp_backchannel: go2rtc 1.9.14 set up the sendonly PCMA/8000 track on a separate talk stream and played a pushed 2 s file; the first ~340 ms of the file's initial burst were trimmed by the 600 ms run-ahead cap
speaker.disconnect_mute: talker dropped mid-sentence over RTSP: speaker idle and muted 0.30 s later, nothing dropped while streaming in real time
speaker.browser_talk: owner talked from the NVR's live view over HTTPS and heard the camera; confirmed both directions
speaker.boot_gate: talk and speaker_enable refused until /run/jooan-local/speaker-hook-released exists; gate released in every boot observed

protocol.onvif_with_audio: NVR keeps pan/tilt and presets with audio in the profile (schema child order)

qualification_limits: One unit, one room; levels judged in a quiet room and by the owner's ear, not against a calibrated source.
Talk tested from one browser and over HTTP; the second-talker refusal and half-duplex mute are covered by host tests, not repeated on the camera.
Volume and gain changes last until the daemon restarts.
The soak with audio on (24-72 h) had not finished when this was written.
